title: Okta targets AI agent token costs with MCP scoping
summary: Okta introduces identity-scoped Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool lists to reduce AI agent token costs by minimizing the 'tool tax' - the overhead of tokens consumed when models process tool schemas, names, descriptions, and parameters for every exposed tool.
problem_solved: Reduces excessive token consumption in AI agent workflows by scoping available tools to only those relevant to a user's identity and permissions.
why_valuable: As AI agent deployments scale, token costs become significant; identity-scoped MCP reduces unnecessary prompt overhead, lowering operational costs while maintaining security.
